scope.implemented: Native opaque material quality with shared GGX stellar/isotropic-environment reflection and high-tier normal/MR/AO maps; shared three-source cascaded raster shadows from retained terrain and mesh buffers; requested/resolved settings, atlas memory budget and telemetry
scope.not_implemented: scene-object reflections/SSR/ray tracing, atmospheric indirect light/clouds/eclipses, HDR/tonemapping/automatic exposure, mip chains, full authored material parity, alpha/transparent casters, shadow-specific terrain residency, light-volume compaction or shadow LOD
scope.ownership: MIT render-core projection math and render-wgpu GPU resources; GPL native scene/policy remains separate; existing shared rcbt-core ocean kernel generalized to RGB F0 with scalar compatibility wrapper
scope.new_gpu_work: one depth render pass per active source/cascade; no pass or atlas/pipeline allocation when shadows.enabled=false

contracts.lighting: existing three-slot linear-lux celestial SurfaceLighting; camera-relative f64-to-f32 transport; source-specific visibility multiplies direct diffuse and stellar specular only
contracts.materials: sRGB base texture; linear G roughness/B metallic and R occlusion; derivative tangent normal frame; AO attenuates indirect only; metals gain no substitute diffuse when reflections are disabled
contracts.quality: Low keeps factor-only source reflections and approximates diffuse/ambient Fresnel by F0; Medium uses view-angle Fresnel with factors; High also uploads authored normal/MR/AO maps
contracts.environment: explicit existing isotropic ambient_lux/PI; native celestial ambient is currently zero; no fabricated sky light
contracts.shadow_covers: 1..4 concentric covers per source; radii=distance*40^((i+1)/count-1); f64 texel snapping, finite light-space caster reach; outer 10% blends to next cover or unshadowed
contracts.shadow_geometry: existing full resident 33x33 terrain grids, not camera-culled active triangle stream; existing mesh vertex/index/instance buffers; inactive terrain slots do not cast; conservative nearby fleet caster retention
contracts.shadow_memory: default 64 MiB cap halves native resolution across 3*cascades Depth32Float layers; default resolves requested 4096 to native 1024: 50331648 bytes / 48 MiB
contracts.shadow_quality: Low one comparison; Medium 3x3 PCF; High 5x5 PCF; adapter texture dimensions and array layers checked
contracts.disabled: shadows.enabled=false: no atlas, shadow pipelines, passes, frame uploads or receiver bindings; specular_reflections=false: no specular contribution and no added reflection passes/resources
contracts.settings: graphics.toml + requested/resolved graphics + GUI descriptors + capture metadata; material/shadow settings require renderer recreation/restart
contracts.legacy: shared raster uses named surface hook defaults with no shadows; native substitutes only the whole hook block, not BRDF/statements; no runtime Bevy dependency added to native

reproduction.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1), Vulkan; same development machine as baseline
reproduction.audio: Native has no audio subsystem. Workspace tests and any legacy app runs use ALSA_CONFIG_PATH=target/render-batch/silent-alsa.conf, inaccessible PULSE_SERVER and PIPEWIRE_REMOTE=thessa-test-no-audio; no system audio settings changed
reproduction.retained_replay: thessa-terrain-native --server-flight --server apps/server/target/test-tmp/baked-render-peer.py --headless target/render-batch/native-surface-retained.png --hud --frames 60 --prestream-seconds 2; peer is the previously generated v10 real-authority separation fixture
reproduction.disabled_controls: Same preview with --graphics target/render-batch/surface-no-shadows.toml or surface-disabled.toml; minimal v1 config, renderer.surface_quality=high, specular_reflections=true/false, shadows.enabled=false

gpu_oracles.cases: Independent colored-source occlusion; mesh and resident-terrain casters; retired terrain stops casting; disabled allocates no atlas; 3e12 m origin; GGX normal incidence; linear MR channels; tangent-space normal and zero scale; degenerate UV fallback; ambient-only AO; metal reflection-disable and Low reflection preservation
gpu_oracles.numeric_bounds: Normal-incidence GGX within two sRGB codes of analytic RGB=(1,.5,.25); projection narrowing under 3 mm in projection space for the tested 24 km interval at 3e12 m origin, not a universal world-space shadow error bound

fixed_source_measurement.boundary: Release fixed sources, no streaming/source publication/readback/compilation in timer; CPU encode/submit plus GPU completion, not isolated GPU timestamps or production FPS. Exposes substantial unoptimized all-resident-grid shadow cost; no performance-win claim

live_stream_measurements.boundary: Live async material populations differ between runs. Complete native frame + GPU completion; not a controlled shadow-isolated comparison, game FPS or network throughput claim

known_limits: Dark captures without atmospheric indirect light; no invented ambient added
No claim of blind subjective preference or visual parity
Only retained terrain casts; off-cover/unresident occluders are absent
Every retained full grid casts into every active cover; no light-space compaction/shadow LOD
Finite shadow reach/fade, map discretization and configured metre-scale bias are not calibrated for every small craft
Wire, authority, physics, GPU topology and libcbt/large_cbt parity are unchanged
